review_notes:
I read the whole target file. I also read Definitions.lean (IsC1SelfMap, standardEmbedding, CounterexampleManifold, CounterexampleAmbient), Embedding.lean (continuous_of_local_contDiff_extension, isC1SelfMap_of_contDiff) and SphereTranslation.lean (denom, ambient, translate, contDiffOn_ambient). A grep showed that HasLocalExtension and translateCoordinate are used only in this file.

I considered four possible generalisations and rejected each:
- Replace C^1 with C^n. IsC1SelfMap is fixed at order 1 in its definition, so this would need a new IsCnSelfMap notion.
- Weaken hf to its local-extension half. Continuity already follows from that half, so this only removes a redundant conjunct and is not a real weakening.
- Let HasLocalExtension take values in a general normed space. It is only ever used with ℂ-valued C and SphereTranslation.translate, so this gains nothing.
- Weaken hasLocalExtension_of_contDiff to ContDiffOn on an open set. This is a small convenience, and the main theorem already takes the local form.

The statements are tied to the specific manifold and to the stereographic translation, so I found no useful generalisation that avoids new mathematics. Remaining uncertainty is low.
